name: Williams Racing F1 FW14b 1992
author: Flamestroke
description:
My Highest detailed model yet!! Williams racing FW14b. A car designed by the genius Adrian Newey, man who can see air, his first designed car to win a chmpionship.  The car with its innovative active suspension was instant success winning both the 1992 World Drivers as well as World Constructors Championship, driven by the infamous RED5 Nigel Mansell and Riccardo Patrese. The FW14B was the dominant car that year and Mansell wrapped up the 1992 Drivers' Championship with a then-record 9 wins in a season, whilst Patrese scored a further win at the Japanese Grand Prix.

- Fixed Texture Issue (02/11/2025)
